classes.name: BOPDS_CommonBlock
classes.summary: The class {@link BOPDS_CommonBlock | `BOPDS_CommonBlock`} is to store the information about pave blocks that have geometrical coincidence (in terms of a tolerance) with: a) other pave block(s); b) face(s).
